request: Write a short README introduction and getting-started paragraph for Parcel, a tool for independent consultants. Facts: it groups client requests by project, shows due dates, and exports CSV files. Start by creating a project and importing a CSV. It runs locally. The implementation is a prototype with only unit tests; that has no known effect on these listed capabilities. No performance study exists.

Answer this user: 'Can I use this scheduler to send my weekly report automatically?' Facts: it can prepare weekly reports on Mondays. Sending is available only after the user approves each report. No unattended sending exists.
Explain to a new office employee why consistent file names help. Use about 100 words and one concrete example. Give enough detail to be useful.

Write the final message for an agent task. User requested a fix to a broken search filter. Facts: code fixed; 18 targeted tests passed; a pull request was opened at https://example.com/pr/12; nothing deployed. The CI pipeline has not completed. The user will review and merge. Keep the message useful.

Write onboarding text for a document summarizer. Facts: it extracts a summary and source-page links from uploaded PDF files. Scanned PDFs are unsupported. Uploaded files are processed on the provider's servers and deleted after 24 hours. No other retention promises are established. Ask the user to choose a PDF.

Write a launch blurb in a lively voice for a pocket notebook called Spark. Facts: 64 dotted pages, recycled-paper cover, fits in a jacket pocket. Audience: people who sketch ideas while traveling. No claims about environmental impact beyond the stated cover material.
